note: One row per surface that can cause physical, fleet, or external effect. A surface is either registered and gated, or it does not ship. An UNGOVERNED_KNOWN row is honest and passes; a MISSING row is the lie this registry exists to catch. See standards/AUTONOMY_STANDARD.md section 2.

surfaces.gate: per-node actuate opt-in, restartPolicy on-failure, exponential backoff, capauth signature when SKFLEET_SIGNING is enforce
surfaces.authorization_object: mechanical tier, below the action contract by design
surfaces.why: A thirty-second restart-on-unhealthy pass under backoff is a thermostat, not a decision-maker. Routing it through ITIL would flood the change log and teach people to ignore it.

surfaces.gate: freeze check inside honor, HONOR_ADAPTERS allowlist, policy.classify_change auto_approvable, execute flag
surfaces.authorization_object: ITIL change fold, via the dispatcher
surfaces.why: Unreachable in practice today: no timer installed and the shipped unit carries no execute flag. Becomes reachable only through the dispatcher.

surfaces.gate: capauth PDP end to end, fails closed when capauth is unreachable
surfaces.why: Feature-gated off by SKOPERATOR_HTTP. This is the reference implementation the stray surfaces are being retrofitted toward.

surfaces.gate: removed from MCP registration and implementation
surfaces.why: Removed by skcapstone PR 199, merge 9c4b8f5dc80288ae892b9bb2587bb540c05e1232. Consumer evidence found no live-run or check-mode consumers and no successful runs. Removal was selected over gating. This historical row remains registered, and its baseline id is explicitly retired, so deletion cannot disguise reintroduction or erase the incident.

surfaces.gate: store.check_actuation_gate (readiness/freeze) then a capauth PDP allow (trustee.restart/trustee.scale/trustee.rotate capabilities, VERIFIED enrollment tier, fails closed when capauth is unreachable) then, for trustee_rotate only, an approved ITIL change (change_is_approved)
surfaces.authorization_object: capauth policy decision; trustee_rotate additionally requires an ITIL change fold to APPROVED status (narrow stand-in pending operator_seat/dispatch.py's shared verifier, card cf12b21d)
surfaces.why: skcapstone PR #200 (on top of #198) landed the gate: refuses with machine-readable reason frozen or unprovisioned per store.check_actuation_gate, then a capauth PDP allow following fleet/operator_http.py's fail-closed authorize() pattern, then for rotate an approved-change check. Enforced inside TrusteeOps itself so cli/agents_trustee.py (agents restart/scale/rotate) is covered too, not only the MCP surface. _audit stays a record, not the gate. A real consequence: TrusteeMonitor's autonomous auto-rotate can no longer complete on its own (no change_id path exists for it yet), which is correct per 'rotation is never routine.'

surfaces.gate: twin gate by import from every merge path, fail-closed protected manifest, automerge_repos empty in all live configs
surfaces.freeze_coverage: n/a, governed by its own operator flags
surfaces.authorization_object: twin gate verdict plus the operator automerge list
surfaces.why: live_execution and automerge_repos are operator flags outside any standard's gift.
